beans.name: Seabright House Blend
beans.description: From our house to yours, Seabright House Blend is undeniably inviting. Seabright showcases apricot and honeydew flavor notes composed of direct trade coffees from El Salvador and Guatemala. A balanced mouthfeel. And aromatics of toasted hazelnuts. Set yourself up for a winning day with one of our easiest drinking blends.

recipes.title: Verve Seabright House Blend Dwell
recipes.description: Verve's Dwell Dripper suggestion for Seabright: 20 g to 300 g at 1:15 on a medium grind, drawn down at 2:20.

recipes.title: Verve Seabright House Blend Aeropress
recipes.description: Verve's AeroPress suggestion for Seabright: 17 g to 255 g at 1:15 on a medium-fine grind, 2:14.

recipes.title: Verve Seabright House Blend Coffee Maker
recipes.description: Verve's coffee-maker suggestion for Seabright: a 30 g batch to 900 g on a medium grind, five minutes.
